FileName.value: Pull Initial PRF Outbound Data from Staging table

scripts.text:
UPDATE AGP.PRF_REJECTED PRFR
SET PRFR.PROCESSED_FLAG = 'Y'
WHERE UPPER(PRFR.INCLUDE_OUTBOUND_FLAG) = 'Y'
    AND UPPER(PRFR.PROCESSED_FLAG) = 'N'
    AND UPPER(PRFR.PRF_TYPE) = 'INITIAL'

FileName.value: Pull Final PRF Outbound Data from Staging table

scripts.text:
UPDATE AGP.PRF_REJECTED PRFR
SET PRFR.PROCESSED_FLAG = 'Y'
WHERE UPPER(PRFR.INCLUDE_OUTBOUND_FLAG) = 'Y'
    AND UPPER(PRFR.PROCESSED_FLAG) = 'N'
    AND UPPER(PRFR.PRF_TYPE) = 'FINAL'

    PRFO.PRF_CALC_OUT_MAP_ID, PRFO.BATCH_ID, PRFO.RECORD_TYPE, PRFO.RID, PRFO.BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT, 
    PRFO.BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT, PRFO.MCE_EFF_DT, PRFO.MCE_TERM_DT, PRFO.MONTHS_MEM_INCURRED, PRFO.MONTHS_ARREARS,

UPDATE AGP.INMCD_PRF_CONTROL PRFC
SET PRFC.RECORD_COUNT = (SELECT /*+parallel(4)+*/ COUNT(1) FROM AGP.PRF_OUTBOUND_FILE_STAGING)
   ,PRFC.FILE_NAME = @FileName                
WHERE PRFC.FILE_TYPE = 'O'
AND PRFC.FILE_PROCESSED_DT = TRUNC(SYSDATE)

DELETE FROM AGP.PRF_CALC_OUTPUT_MAPPING PRFO
WHERE UPPER(PRFO.PRF_TYPE) IN ('INITIAL','FINAL')
AND EXISTS (SELECT  PRFA.RID FROM AGP.PRF_CALC_OUT_MAP_ARCHIVE PRFA WHERE PRFA.RID = PRFO.RID AND PRFA.BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT = PRFO.BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT AND PRFA.RECORD_TYPE = PRFO.RECORD_TYPE)

FinalPRFRecordCount.defaultValue: 'SELECT 'T'||LTRIM(TO_CHAR(COUNT(1)+1,'00000000')) AS FINAL_PRF_RECORD_COUNT\nFROM AGP.PRF_OUTBOUND_FILE_STAGING PRFS\nWHERE UPPER(PRFS.PRF_TYPE) = 'FINAL' AND NVL(PRFS.ERROR_FLAG,'Y')<>'E''

InitialPRFRecordCount.defaultValue: 'SELECT 'T'||LTRIM(TO_CHAR(COUNT(1)+1,'00000000')) AS INITIAL_PRF_RECORD_COUNT \nFROM AGP.PRF_OUTBOUND_FILE_STAGING PRFS\nWHERE UPPER(PRFS.PRF_TYPE) = 'INITIAL' AND NVL(PRFS.ERROR_FLAG,'Y')<>'E''
